title: Staff and Admin panels
summary: Admins now move between a Staff panel and an Admin panel, with a new admin overview page. Nothing changes for anyone else.

added: An admin overview page that links to each admin section you can open.
For admins, a Staff and Admin switch at the top of the menu. The name under the logo says which panel you are in.
changed: Admin pages always show the Admin menu, and every other page shows the Staff menu, so the menu stays put when you refresh, go back or open a new tab.
The Normal menu is now called the Staff menu.
accessibility: The Staff and Admin switch works with a keyboard and with screen readers, marks the panel you are in, and has large targets on small screens.

internal_notes: The panel is decided by the page address, and no menu mode is stored any more. Every admin page keeps its own permission and fresh sign-in checks.

Developer changes ship in this release too: one version-shipping rule with milestone version tooling, the Laragon preview through FastCGI with a live preview gate, GitHub dependency review, and faster release builds and deploys.
